name: Dismantlable-Ample Obstruction Frontier
statement: The nonample pc-minimal obstructions to dismantlable ampleness are exactly $Q_n^{--}$ for $n\geq3$. Hall's 299-concept maximum class is an additional ample pc-minimal obstruction. No ample partial cube on at most fourteen vertices fails to be dismantlable ample; consequently the minimum order of an ample obstruction lies between 15 and 299 inclusive.
proof: The ample-class forbidden-minor theorem and pc-minimality force every nonample obstruction to equal a contained $Q_n^{--}$. Elementary minors verify minimality of those graphs. Hall's absence of corners is published, and exact corner-peeling certificates for its 36 elementary pc-minors prove its minimality. An exhaustive cube-isomorphism census through order fourteen, completed by the low-excess structural lemma in high isometric dimension, gives the lower bound.
comments: The complete ample obstruction family remains open; this record states the proved frontier only.
